answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make identity costly: each agent staking a small deposit that is slashed if its peer attestations turn out fake, while reputation scores decay unless renewed. Picture a verification garden where every trust vertex is rooted like a hardy yarrow plant, and each new vote is a vine that must climb only along paths other agents have already attested as genuine. Cloning wallets becomes pointless because fresh clones start with zero rooted reputation and cannot borrow trust.
